tasks.subject: Task 1: Add JobMetricsReport model and JobMetricsNodeComponent
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A typed, recursive model for the metrics JSON shape, and a self-recursive component that renders it as a visual tree, fully covered by tests.

**Files:**
- Create: libs/maia-ui-workspace/projects/maia-jobs/src/lib/jobs-dashboard/models/JobMetricsReport.ts
- Create: libs/maia-ui-workspace/projects/maia-jobs/src/lib/jobs-dashboard/dialogs/job-metrics-dialog/components/job-metrics-node/job-metrics-node.component.ts
- Create: .../job-metrics-node/job-metrics-node.component.html
- Create: .../job-metrics-node/job-metrics-node.component.scss
- Test: .../job-metrics-node/job-metrics-node.component.spec.ts

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] JobMetricsReport models jobName, jobCount, context, totalElapsedTime, optional min/median/95th/max/mean, optional counters, optional ratios, optional recursive childJobs
- [ ] Component renders job name and totalElapsedTime.formatted for a leaf node
- [ ] Timing stats render only when min is present
- [ ] Context/counters/ratios sections render only when present
- [ ] childJobs render recursively (2 levels deep verified)
- [ ] Chevron toggle hides/shows the child list

**Verify:** cd libs/maia-ui-workspace && npx ng test maia-jobs -> all tests pass

See plan file for full code for every step (model, spec, component, template, styles).
